question: The Prime Minister of India has launched the PM PVTG Mission in November 2023. In this context, there are how many PVTGs in 18 states & UTs?
solution:
The correct answer is __**75**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** PM PVTG Mission, launched in November 2023**
 
• It a**ims to provide comprehensive development for the Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs) across India**.
 
• There are **75 PVTGs** located in 18 states and Union Territories</
